2 Oniks supersonic cruise missiles impacted at/near Chornomorsk Port, Odesa Oblast. The Russian Ministry of Defence announced targeting the Chornomorsk Port in Odesa Obalst with two Oniks supersonic cruise missiles launched from Crimea. They claim that facilities used to store fuel and lubricants for the Ukrainian military were struck. The MoD also claims to have struck the "Karolino" 110 kV electrical substation in the neaby town of Karolino-Buhaz with Geran-4 jet-drones, as well as a barge vessel in the western Black Sea.
